```{r}
# Required packages
if (!requireNamespace("Matrix", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'Matrix' is required. Please install it with install.packages('Matrix').")
}

kalman_skeleton_smoother <- function(coords_data,
                                    priors, max_skel_sd_mult = 3, motion_alpha = 50,
                                    smooth_weight = 0.9, # Weight on smoothed predictions in final predictions (mixed with original predictions)
                                    q = 10,                 # process noise variance (per-dim)
                                    obs_sd = 5,             # observation noise sd for reliable coordinates
                                    angle_weight = 1,
                                    prior_strength = 1,
                                    verbose = FALSE) {
  # --- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
  dist_xy <- function(a,b) {
    if (any(is.na(a)) || any(is.na(b))) return(NA_real_)
    sqrt( (a[1]-b[1])^2 + (a[2]-b[2])^2 )
  }

  state_idx <- function(part, axis) {
    # ordering: nose(1,2), mid(3,4), tail(5,6)
    base <- switch(part,
                   nose = 0,
                   mid  = 2,
                   tail = 4,
                   stop("bad part"))
    if (axis == "x") return(base + 1)
    if (axis == "y") return(base + 2)
    stop("bad axis")
  }

  # --- skeleton functions: distances (NM, TM, TN) and angle at mid (nose-mid vs tail-mid) ---
  g_distances <- function(xstate) {
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]
    mid  <- xstate[c(3,4)]
    tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    c(dist_xy(nose, mid), dist_xy(tail, mid), dist_xy(tail, nose))
  }

  # angle between A = nose - mid and B = tail - mid
  g_angle <- function(xstate) {
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]; mid <- xstate[c(3,4)]; tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    A <- nose - mid; B <- tail - mid
    dot <- A[1]*B[1] + A[2]*B[2]
    det <- A[1]*B[2] - A[2]*B[1]
    atan2(det, dot)  # value in [-pi, pi]
  }

  # Jacobian of distances (3x6) - same as before
  jacobian_g <- function(xstate) {
    J <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 6)
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]; mid <- xstate[c(3,4)]; tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    set_row <- function(row, a_idx, b_idx, a_pt, b_pt) {
      dvec <- a_pt - b_pt
      d <- sqrt(sum(dvec^2))
      if (d <= 1e-8) return(NULL)
      da <- dvec / d
      db <- -dvec / d
      J[row, a_idx:(a_idx+1)] <<- da
      J[row, b_idx:(b_idx+1)] <<- db
      NULL
    }
    set_row(1, 1, 3, nose, mid)   # NM: nose - mid
    set_row(2, 5, 3, tail, mid)   # TM: tail - mid
    set_row(3, 5, 1, tail, nose)  # TN: tail - nose
    J
  }

  # Jacobian of the angle θ = atan2(det, dot) wrt state (1 x 6)
  jacobian_angle <- function(xstate) {
    # order: [n_x, n_y, m_x, m_y, t_x, t_y]
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]; mid <- xstate[c(3,4)]; tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    A <- nose - mid
    B <- tail - mid
    dot <- A[1]*B[1] + A[2]*B[2]
    det <- A[1]*B[2] - A[2]*B[1]
    denom <- det^2 + dot^2
    if (denom <= 1e-12) {
      # near-collinear / degenerate -> return zeros to avoid numeric blowups
      return(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = 6))
    }

    # partials of det:
    # ∂det/∂n_x =  B_y
    # ∂det/∂n_y = -B_x
    # ∂det/∂t_x = -A_y
    # ∂det/∂t_y =  A_x
    # ∂det/∂m_x = -B_y + A_y
    # ∂det/∂m_y = -A_x + B_x
    pd_det <- numeric(6)
    pd_det[1] <-  B[2]            # n_x
    pd_det[2] <- -B[1]            # n_y
    pd_det[5] <- -A[2]            # t_x
    pd_det[6] <-  A[1]            # t_y
    pd_det[3] <- -B[2] + A[2]     # m_x
    pd_det[4] <- -A[1] + B[1]     # m_y

    # partials of dot:
    # ∂dot/∂n_x = B_x
    # ∂dot/∂n_y = B_y
    # ∂dot/∂t_x = A_x
    # ∂dot/∂t_y = A_y
    # ∂dot/∂m_x = -B_x - A_x
    # ∂dot/∂m_y = -B_y - A_y
    pd_dot <- numeric(6)
    pd_dot[1] <- B[1]
    pd_dot[2] <- B[2]
    pd_dot[5] <- A[1]
    pd_dot[6] <- A[2]
    pd_dot[3] <- -B[1] - A[1]
    pd_dot[4] <- -B[2] - A[2]

    grad <- (dot * pd_det - det * pd_dot) / denom
    matrix(as.numeric(grad), nrow = 1)  # 1 x 6
  }

  make_H_obs <- function(obs_mask) {
    # obs_mask: logical length 3 (nose,mid,tail) indicating which parts are observed and reliable
    rows <- which(obs_mask)
    if (length(rows) == 0) return(list(H = matrix(0, 0, 6), z = numeric(0)))
    H <- matrix(0, nrow = 2 * length(rows), ncol = 6)
    z_len <- nrow(H)
    z <- numeric(z_len)
    r <- 1
    for (ri in rows) {
      part <- c("nose","mid","tail")[ri]
      ix <- state_idx(part, "x")
      iy <- state_idx(part, "y")
      H[r, ix] <- 1
      H[r+1, iy] <- 1
      r <- r + 2
    }
    list(H = H, z = z)
  }

  msafe_inv <- function(M) {
    tryCatch(solve(M), error = function(e) solve(M + diag(1e-8, nrow(M))))
  }

  # --- checks & prep -------------------------------------------------------
  # now require NM, TM, TN and ANGLE in priors
  if (!all(c("NM","TM","TN","ANGLE") %in% names(priors))) stop("priors must contain NM, TM, TN, and ANGLE (mean, sd)")
  skel_sd_vec <- as.numeric(c(priors$NM["sd"], priors$TM["sd"], priors$TN["sd"]))
  skel_mean_vec <- as.numeric(c(priors$NM["mean"], priors$TM["mean"], priors$TN["mean"]))
  angle_sd <- as.numeric(priors$ANGLE["sd"])
  angle_mean <- as.numeric(priors$ANGLE["mean"])
  if (any(is.na(skel_sd_vec) | skel_sd_vec <= 0)) stop("skeleton prior sds must be positive numbers")
  if (is.na(angle_sd) || angle_sd <= 0) stop("ANGLE prior sd must be positive")

  # required columns names (expects lowercase part keys as in your supplied tibble)
  required_cols0 <- c("inst0_nose_x","inst0_nose_y","inst0_mid_x","inst0_mid_y","inst0_tail_x","inst0_tail_y",
                      "reliability_nose0","reliability_mid0","reliability_tail0")
  required_cols1 <- c("inst1_nose_x","inst1_nose_y","inst1_mid_x","inst1_mid_y","inst1_tail_x","inst1_tail_y",
                      "reliability_nose1","reliability_mid1","reliability_tail1")
  if (!all(required_cols0 %in% colnames(coords_data))) stop("coords_data missing required inst0 columns")
  if (!all(required_cols1 %in% colnames(coords_data))) stop("coords_data missing required inst1 columns")

  coords_pred <- coords_data  # copy
  n_rows <- nrow(coords_data)
  parts <- c("nose","mid","tail")

  # add pred & sd cols
  for (inst in 0:1) {
    for (p in parts) {
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_pred") ]] <- NA_real_
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_pred") ]] <- NA_real_
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_sd") ]]   <- NA_real_
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_sd") ]]   <- NA_real_
    }
  }

  # Kalman matrices
  A <- diag(6)
  Q <- diag(q, 6)
  I6 <- diag(6)

  # main per-instance loop
  for (inst in 0:1) {
    if (verbose) message("Processing instance ", inst)

    # build obs matrix (n x 6) and reliability flags (n x 3)
    # --- build obs matrix and reliability flags ---
# --- build obs matrix and reliability flags, then pre-filter adjust ---
obs_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_rows, ncol = 6)
rel_mat <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = n_rows, ncol = 3)

for (t in seq_len(n_rows)) {
  row <- coords_data[t, ]
  
  # fill obs_mat
  obs_mat[t, state_idx("nose","x")] <- as.numeric(row[[ paste0("inst",inst,"_nose_x") ]])
  obs_mat[t, state_idx("nose","y")] <- as.numeric(row[[ paste0("inst",inst,"_nose_y") ]])
  obs_mat[t, state_idx("mid","x")]  <- as.numeric(row[[ paste0("inst",inst,"_mid_x") ]])
  obs_mat[t, state_idx("mid","y")]  <- as.numeric(row[[ paste0("inst",inst,"_mid_y") ]])
  obs_mat[t, state_idx("tail","x")] <- as.numeric(row[[ paste0("inst",inst,"_tail_x") ]])
  obs_mat[t, state_idx("tail","y")] <- as.numeric(row[[ paste0("inst",inst,"_tail_y") ]])
  
  # fill rel_mat
  rel_mat[t, 1] <- isTRUE(as.logical(row[[ paste0("reliability_nose",inst) ]]))
  rel_mat[t, 2] <- isTRUE(as.logical(row[[ paste0("reliability_mid",inst) ]]))
  rel_mat[t, 3] <- isTRUE(as.logical(row[[ paste0("reliability_tail",inst) ]]))
}

# --- PRE-FILTER: adjust observed distances for reliable frames ---
adjust_dist <- function(a, b, target_d) {
  v <- a - b
  d <- sqrt(sum(v^2))
  if (is.na(d) || d < 1e-8) return(a)
  b + v * (target_d / d)
}

d_mean <- skel_mean_vec
d_sd   <- skel_sd_vec
d_min  <- d_mean - max_skel_sd_mult * d_sd
d_max  <- d_mean + max_skel_sd_mult * d_sd

for (t in seq_len(n_rows)) {

  # extract coordinates
  nose_idx <- c(state_idx("nose", "x"), state_idx("nose", "y"))
  mid_idx  <- c(state_idx("mid",  "x"), state_idx("mid",  "y"))
  tail_idx <- c(state_idx("tail", "x"), state_idx("tail", "y"))

  nose <- obs_mat[t, nose_idx]
  mid  <- obs_mat[t, mid_idx]
  tail <- obs_mat[t, tail_idx]

  # Nose–Mid
  NM <- sqrt(sum((nose - mid)^2))
  if (!is.na(NM) && (NM < d_min[1] || NM > d_max[1])) {
    nose <- adjust_dist(nose, mid, min(max(NM, d_min[1]), d_max[1]))
  }

  # Tail–Mid
  TM <- sqrt(sum((tail - mid)^2))
  if (!is.na(TM) && (TM < d_min[2] || TM > d_max[2])) {
    tail <- adjust_dist(tail, mid, min(max(TM, d_min[2]), d_max[2]))
  }

  # update obs_mat with adjusted coordinates
  obs_mat[t, nose_idx] <- nose
  obs_mat[t, tail_idx] <- tail
}

Tlen <- n_rows

    # storage
    x_pred_fwd <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = Tlen)
    P_pred_fwd <- array(0, dim = c(6,6,Tlen))
    x_filt <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = Tlen)
    P_filt <- array(0, dim = c(6,6,Tlen))

    # init
    x_prev <- rep(0, 6)
    P_prev <- diag(1e4, 6)
    first_obs_idx <- which(!is.na(obs_mat[1, ]))
    if (length(first_obs_idx) > 0) {
      x_prev[first_obs_idx] <- obs_mat[1, first_obs_idx]
      for (ii in first_obs_idx) P_prev[ii, ii] <- obs_sd^2
    }

    # forward filter
    for (t in seq_len(Tlen)) {
      # predict
      xpred <- as.numeric(A %*% x_prev)
      Ppred <- A %*% P_prev %*% t(A) + Q

      # build observed-coordinate measurement (only reliable parts)
      obs_flags <- rel_mat[t, ]
      obs_info <- make_H_obs(obs_flags)
      H_obs <- obs_info$H
      z_obs <- numeric(nrow(H_obs))
      if (nrow(H_obs) > 0) {
        r_idx <- 1
        for (pi in which(obs_flags)) {
          px <- obs_mat[t, state_idx(c("nose","mid","tail")[pi], "x")]
          py <- obs_mat[t, state_idx(c("nose","mid","tail")[pi], "y")]
          z_obs[r_idx] <- px; z_obs[r_idx+1] <- py
          r_idx <- r_idx + 2
        }
        R_obs <- diag(obs_sd^2, nrow(H_obs))
      } else {
        R_obs <- matrix(0, 0, 0)
      }

      # --- skeleton pseudo-observation: distances + angle ---
      g_pred <- g_distances(xpred)
      z_skel <- skel_mean_vec
      H_skel_dist <- jacobian_g(xpred)     # 3 x 6

      # angle
      ang_pred <- g_angle(xpred)
      z_ang <- angle_mean
      H_ang <- jacobian_angle(xpred)       # 1 x 6

      # compute raw innovation and wrap to [-pi, pi]
innov_raw_ang <- z_ang - ang_pred
innov_wrapped_ang <- ((innov_raw_ang + pi) %% (2 * pi)) - pi

# no capping — just use wrapped innovation directly
z_ang_wrapped <- ang_pred + innov_wrapped_ang

# combine distance and angle parts
H_skel <- rbind(H_skel_dist, H_ang)  # 4 x 6
z_skel_comb <- c(z_skel, z_ang_wrapped)

# apply tunable weight between distance and angle priors
R_skel <- as.matrix(Matrix::bdiag(
  diag(as.numeric(skel_sd_vec^2), 3) * prior_strength * (1 - angle_weight),   # smaller angle_weight → stronger distance prior
  matrix(angle_sd^2 * (prior_strength * angle_weight), 1, 1)              # larger angle_weight → stronger angle prior
))



      # combine with observed coordinates if any
      if (nrow(H_obs) > 0) {
        H_comb <- rbind(H_obs, H_skel)
        z_comb <- c(z_obs, z_skel_comb)
        # use Matrix::bdiag safely
        R_comb <- as.matrix(Matrix::bdiag(R_obs, R_skel))
      } else {
        H_comb <- H_skel
        z_comb <- z_skel_comb
        R_comb <- as.matrix(R_skel)
      }

      # EKF-like linear update
      S <- H_comb %*% Ppred %*% t(H_comb) + R_comb
      S_inv <- msafe_inv(S)
      K <- Ppred %*% t(H_comb) %*% S_inv
      innov <- z_comb - as.numeric(H_comb %*% xpred)
      xupd <- as.numeric(xpred + K %*% innov)
      Pupd <- (I6 - K %*% H_comb) %*% Ppred
      Pupd <- (Pupd + t(Pupd)) / 2

      # store
      x_pred_fwd[, t] <- xpred
      P_pred_fwd[,, t] <- Ppred
      x_filt[, t] <- xupd
      P_filt[,, t] <- Pupd

      # next
      x_prev <- xupd
      P_prev <- Pupd
    } # forward

    # Backward RTS smoother
    x_smooth <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = Tlen)
    P_smooth <- array(0, dim = c(6,6,Tlen))
    x_smooth[, Tlen] <- x_filt[, Tlen]
    P_smooth[,, Tlen] <- P_filt[,, Tlen]
    if (Tlen >= 2) {
      for (t in seq(Tlen-1, 1)) {
        Pf <- P_filt[,, t]
        Pp1 <- P_pred_fwd[,, t+1]
        C <- Pf %*% t(A) %*% msafe_inv(Pp1)
        x_smooth[, t] <- x_filt[, t] + C %*% (x_smooth[, t+1] - x_pred_fwd[, t+1])
        P_smooth[,, t] <- P_filt[,, t] + C %*% (P_smooth[,, t+1] - Pp1) %*% t(C)
        P_smooth[,, t] <- (P_smooth[,, t] + t(P_smooth[,, t])) / 2
      }
    }

    # ----- ----------  <--- **WINDOW WEIGHTING LOGIC ADDED HERE**  -----------------------
    for (t in seq_len(Tlen)) {
      xs <- x_smooth[, t]
      Ps <- P_smooth[,, t]
      sds <- sqrt(pmax(0, diag(Ps)))
      for (p in parts) {
        ix <- state_idx(p, "x"); iy <- state_idx(p, "y")
        col_x_pred <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_pred")
        col_y_pred <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_pred")
        col_x_sd   <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_sd")
        col_y_sd   <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_sd")

part_idx <- match(p, c("nose","mid","tail"))
ix <- state_idx(p, "x")
iy <- state_idx(p, "y")

# reliability function
is_rel <- function(ii) {
  ii >= 1 && ii <= Tlen &&
    isTRUE(rel_mat[ii, part_idx]) &&
    !is.na(obs_mat[ii, ix]) && !is.na(obs_mat[ii, iy])
}

is_rel <- function(ii) {
  # frame indices to check: previous, current, next (within bounds)
  neighbors <- pmax(1, ii - 1):pmin(Tlen, ii + 1)
  
  # check reliability for all neighbors
  all(sapply(neighbors, function(f) {
    isTRUE(rel_mat[f, part_idx]) &&
      !is.na(obs_mat[f, ix]) &&
      !is.na(obs_mat[f, iy])
  }))
}

is_rel <- function(ii) {
  # check current frame reliability
  if (!isTRUE(rel_mat[ii, part_idx]) ||
      any(is.na(obs_mat[ii, c(ix, iy)]))) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  # get neighbor frames within bounds
  neighbors <- setdiff(pmax(1, ii - 1):pmin(Tlen, ii + 1), ii)

  # current frame coordinates
  cur_xy <- obs_mat[ii, c(ix, iy)]

  # check that all existing neighbors (if any) have valid coords and
  # are within motion_alpha distance (and not identical)
  for (f in neighbors) {
    neigh_xy <- obs_mat[f, c(ix, iy)]
    if (any(is.na(neigh_xy))) return(FALSE)
    dist <- sqrt(sum((cur_xy - neigh_xy)^2))
    if (dist == 0 || dist > motion_alpha) return(FALSE)
  }

  TRUE
}

# Apply rule:
if (is_rel(t)) {
  coords_pred[[col_x_pred]][t] <- obs_mat[t, ix]
  coords_pred[[col_y_pred]][t] <- obs_mat[t, iy]
} else {
  coords_pred[[col_x_pred]][t] <- smooth_weight * xs[ix] + (1 - smooth_weight) * obs_mat[t, ix]
  coords_pred[[col_y_pred]][t] <- smooth_weight * xs[iy] + (1 - smooth_weight) * obs_mat[t, iy]
}

        # keep sd from smoothed posterior (unchanged)
        coords_pred[[ col_x_sd ]][t] <- sds[ix]
        coords_pred[[ col_y_sd ]][t] <- sds[iy]
      }
    }
    # -----  end window weighting logic  ---------------------------------------------------

    if (verbose) message("Instance ", inst, " smoothing done.")
  } # instances loop

  if (verbose) message("Kalman + skeleton smoothing complete with angle prior.")
  coords_pred
}
```

```{r}
priors <- list(
  NM = c(mean = pri_list$pri_dnm_mean, sd = pri_list$pri_dnm_sd),
  TM = c(mean = pri_list$pri_dtm_mean, sd = pri_list$pri_dtm_sd),
  TN = c(mean = pri_list$pri_dtn_mean, sd = pri_list$pri_dtn_sd),
  ANGLE = c(mean = pri_list$circ_mean, sd = pri_list$circ_sd)   # mean in radians, sd in radians
)

coords_pred <- kalman_skeleton_smoother(coords_data, priors,  smooth_weight = 0.8,
q = 30, max_skel_sd_mult = 3, motion_alpha = 50,
obs_sd = 8,                   angle_weight = 0.9,                               prior_strength = 3,
verbose = TRUE)

# Save for later
saveRDS(coords_pred, "coords_pred_strict_and_swapped.rds")

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)

# --- Subset frames ---
res_1000 <- coords_pred %>%
  filter(frame >= 10000, frame <= 12000)

# --- Pivot predicted coordinates for Instance 0 ---
coords0_pred <- res_1000 %>%
  dplyr::select(frame,
                inst0_nose_x_pred, inst0_nose_y_pred,
                inst0_mid_x_pred,  inst0_mid_y_pred,
                inst0_tail_x_pred, inst0_tail_y_pred) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -frame,
    names_to = c("body_part", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "inst0_(nose|mid|tail)_([xy])_pred"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    body_part = dplyr::recode(body_part,
                              nose = "Nose",
                              mid = "Mid-center",
                              tail = "Tail-base"),
    instance = "Instance 0"
  )

# --- Pivot predicted coordinates for Instance 1 ---
coords1_pred <- res_1000 %>%
  dplyr::select(frame,
                inst1_nose_x_pred, inst1_nose_y_pred,
                inst1_mid_x_pred,  inst1_mid_y_pred,
                inst1_tail_x_pred, inst1_tail_y_pred) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -frame,
    names_to = c("body_part", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "inst1_(nose|mid|tail)_([xy])_pred"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    body_part = dplyr::recode(body_part,
                              nose = "Nose",
                              mid = "Mid-center",
                              tail = "Tail-base"),
    instance = "Instance 1"
  )

# --- Combine Instances ---
df_pred_anim <- bind_rows(coords0_pred, coords1_pred) %>%
  mutate(
    size = 15,
    marker_symbol = ifelse(instance == "Instance 0", "circle", "triangle-up")
  )

# --- Plot ---
fig_pred <- plot_ly()

for (inst in unique(df_pred_anim$instance)) {
  df_inst <- df_pred_anim %>% filter(instance == inst)

  fig_pred <- fig_pred %>%
    add_trace(
      data = df_inst,
      x = ~x, y = ~y,
      frame = ~frame,
      color = ~body_part,
      colors = c("Nose" = "red",
                 "Mid-center" = "blue",
                 "Tail-base" = "green"),
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+lines',
      line = list(width = 2),
      marker = list(size = ~size, symbol = ~marker_symbol)
    )
}

# --- Flip Y-axis for video coordinates ---
fig_pred <- fig_pred %>%
  layout(
    title = "Kalman-smoothed predictions",
    xaxis = list(title = "X"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Y (video coords)",
      autorange = "reversed",   # flips vertically
      scaleanchor = "x"
    )
  ) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 40, transition = 0, redraw = FALSE)

fig_pred
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Build pred_clean from coords_pred ---
pred_clean <- coords_pred %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("inst\\d+_(nose|mid|tail)_(x_pred|y_pred|x_sd|y_sd)$"),
    names_to = c("instance", "node", "coord", "stat"),
    names_pattern = "inst(\\d+)_(nose|mid|tail)_(x|y)_(pred|sd)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c("coord", "stat"),
    values_from = "value"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    x_m_pred = x_pred,
    y_m_pred = y_pred,
    x_sd = x_sd,
    y_sd = y_sd
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frame = as.integer(frame),
    instance = as.integer(instance),
    node = str_to_lower(node)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    node = case_when(
      node %in% c("mid-center", "mid_center", "center") ~ "mid",
      node %in% c("tail-base", "tail_base", "base") ~ "tail",
      TRUE ~ node
    )
  )


# --- Clean manual coordinates ---
manual_clean <- manual %>%
  mutate(
    node = str_to_lower(node),
    node = case_when(
      node %in% c("mid-center", "mid_center", "center") ~ "mid",
      node %in% c("tail-base", "tail_base", "base") ~ "tail",
      TRUE ~ node
    ),
    frame = as.integer(frame),
    instance = as.integer(instance)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    x_true = x,
    y_true = y
  )

# --- 1. Join predictions and manual coordinates ---
df_eval <- pred_clean %>%
  inner_join(manual_clean,
             by = c("frame", "instance", "node")) %>%
  rename(body_part = node)

# --- 2. Determine per-frame if swapping manual coordinates reduces MSFE ---
df_swap_flags <- df_eval %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  summarise(
    msfe_no_swap = mean((x_m_pred[instance == 0] - x_true[instance == 0])^2 +
                        (y_m_pred[instance == 0] - y_true[instance == 0])^2 +
                        (x_m_pred[instance == 1] - x_true[instance == 1])^2 +
                        (y_m_pred[instance == 1] - y_true[instance == 1])^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    msfe_swap = mean((x_m_pred[instance == 0] - x_true[instance == 1])^2 +
                     (y_m_pred[instance == 0] - y_true[instance == 1])^2 +
                     (x_m_pred[instance == 1] - x_true[instance == 0])^2 +
                     (y_m_pred[instance == 1] - y_true[instance == 0])^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(best_swap = msfe_swap < msfe_no_swap)

# --- 3. Apply swaps where they improve MSFE ---
df_eval_eff <- df_eval %>%
  left_join(df_swap_flags %>% dplyr::select(frame, best_swap), by = "frame") %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df_frame <- .
    if (isTRUE(df_frame$best_swap[1])) {
      inst0_idx <- which(df_frame$instance == 0)
      inst1_idx <- which(df_frame$instance == 1)
      
      tmp_x <- df_frame$x_true[inst0_idx]
      tmp_y <- df_frame$y_true[inst0_idx]
      
      df_frame$x_true[inst0_idx] <- df_frame$x_true[inst1_idx]
      df_frame$y_true[inst0_idx] <- df_frame$y_true[inst1_idx]
      
      df_frame$x_true[inst1_idx] <- tmp_x
      df_frame$y_true[inst1_idx] <- tmp_y
    }
    df_frame
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(frame, instance, body_part)

# --- 4. Compute overall and per-frame MSFE ---
msfe_overall <- mean((df_eval_eff$x_m_pred - df_eval_eff$x_true)^2 +
                     (df_eval_eff$y_m_pred - df_eval_eff$y_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Overall MSFE after optimal swaps:", round(msfe_overall, 3), "\n")

msfe_by_frame <- df_eval_eff %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  summarise(
    msfe = mean((x_m_pred - x_true)^2 + (y_m_pred - y_true)^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 5. PIT diagnostics (2D Gaussian posterior predictive, radial distance) ---
df_pit <- df_eval_eff %>%
  mutate(
    # Mahalanobis-like radial distance, assuming independent x/y Gaussians
    z_dist = sqrt(((x_true - x_m_pred)^2 / x_sd^2) + ((y_true - y_m_pred)^2 / y_sd^2)),
    # PIT value from 2D standard normal radial CDF: F(r) = 1 - exp(-r^2 / 2)
    pit = 1 - exp(-z_dist^2 / 2)
  )

# --- 6. PIT histogram (single overall calibration plot) ---
ggplot(df_pit, aes(x = pit)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = nrow(df_pit) / 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "PITs (2D Gaussian Posterior Predictive)",
    x = "PIT value",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal()


# --- 7. Plot predictions
# --- Helper: draw SD ellipse ---
ellipse_points <- function(xc, yc, x_sd, y_sd, level = 1, n = 100) {
  theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n)
  tibble(
    x = xc + level * x_sd * cos(theta),
    y = yc + level * y_sd * sin(theta)
  )
}

# --- Function to plot one frame ---
plot_frame <- function(frame_id) {
  df_frame <- df_eval %>%
    filter(frame == frame_id) %>%
    mutate(instance = factor(instance))

  sd_circles <- df_frame %>%
    mutate(list_sd = pmap(list(x_m_pred, y_m_pred, x_sd, y_sd, body_part, instance),
                          function(xc, yc, xs, ys, bp, inst) {
                            map_dfr(1:3, \(lvl)
                              ellipse_points(xc, yc, xs, ys, level = lvl) %>%
                                mutate(level = lvl, body_part = bp, instance = inst))
                          })) %>%
    select(list_sd) %>%
    unnest(list_sd) %>%
    mutate(instance = factor(instance))

  # --- Build true skeleton connections (nose → mid → tail) ---
  true_lines <- df_frame %>%
    filter(body_part %in% c("nose", "mid", "tail")) %>%
    arrange(instance, factor(body_part, levels = c("nose", "mid", "tail"))) %>%
    group_by(instance) %>%
    summarise(
      x = list(x_true),
      y = list(y_true),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(line_df = map2(x, y, \(xx, yy) tibble(x = xx, y = yy))) %>%
    select(instance, line_df) %>%
    unnest(line_df)

  ggplot() +
    # SD ellipses
    geom_path(data = sd_circles,
              aes(x, y, group = interaction(body_part, level, instance), color = body_part),
              linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    # True skeleton (nose–mid–tail)
    geom_path(data = true_lines,
              aes(x, y, group = instance),
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
    # Predicted points
    geom_point(data = df_frame,
               aes(x_m_pred, y_m_pred, color = body_part, shape = instance),
               size = 3) +
    # True points
    geom_point(data = df_frame,
               aes(x_true, y_true),
               color = "black", shape = 4, size = 3) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 16, "1" = 17)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_y_reverse() +  # ← Properly reverse the vertical axis
    labs(
      title = paste("Predicted vs True Body Parts — Frame", frame_id),
      x = "X", y = "Y"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# --- List of frames to visualize ---
frame_ids <- c(1673, 7348, 17157)

# --- Generate and display all plots ---
plots <- map(frame_ids, plot_frame)

# Show individually:
plots[[1]]
plots[[2]]
plots[[3]]



# --- 8. Preview merged dataset ---
df_preview <- df_eval_eff %>%
  dplyr::select(frame, instance, body_part, x_m_pred, y_m_pred, x_true, y_true) %>%
  arrange(frame, instance, body_part)

print(head(df_preview, 10))
```

```{r}
# --- Build pred_clean from raw coords_pred (unsmoothed) ---
pred_clean_raw <- coords_pred %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("inst\\d+_(nose|mid|tail)_(x|y)$"),
    names_to = c("instance", "node", "coord"),
    names_pattern = "inst(\\d+)_(nose|mid|tail)_(x|y)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = coord,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  rename(x_m_pred = x, y_m_pred = y) %>%
  mutate(
    frame = as.integer(frame),
    instance = as.integer(instance),
    node = str_to_lower(node),
    node = case_when(
      node %in% c("mid-center", "mid_center", "center") ~ "mid",
      node %in% c("tail-base", "tail_base", "base") ~ "tail",
      TRUE ~ node
    )
  )

# --- Clean manual coordinates (same as before) ---
manual_clean <- manual %>%
  mutate(
    node = str_to_lower(node),
    node = case_when(
      node %in% c("mid-center", "mid_center", "center") ~ "mid",
      node %in% c("tail-base", "tail_base", "base") ~ "tail",
      TRUE ~ node
    ),
    frame = as.integer(frame),
    instance = as.integer(instance)
  ) %>%
  rename(x_true = x, y_true = y)

# --- 1. Join raw predictions and manual coordinates ---
df_eval_raw <- pred_clean_raw %>%
  inner_join(manual_clean,
             by = c("frame", "instance", "node")) %>%
  rename(body_part = node)

# --- 2. Compute per-frame MSFE (with and without optimal swaps) ---
df_swap_flags_raw <- df_eval_raw %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  summarise(
    msfe_no_swap = mean((x_m_pred[instance == 0] - x_true[instance == 0])^2 +
                        (y_m_pred[instance == 0] - y_true[instance == 0])^2 +
                        (x_m_pred[instance == 1] - x_true[instance == 1])^2 +
                        (y_m_pred[instance == 1] - y_true[instance == 1])^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    msfe_swap = mean((x_m_pred[instance == 0] - x_true[instance == 1])^2 +
                     (y_m_pred[instance == 0] - y_true[instance == 1])^2 +
                     (x_m_pred[instance == 1] - x_true[instance == 0])^2 +
                     (y_m_pred[instance == 1] - y_true[instance == 0])^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(best_swap = msfe_swap < msfe_no_swap)

# --- 3. Apply swaps where beneficial ---
df_eval_eff_raw <- df_eval_raw %>%
  left_join(df_swap_flags_raw %>% dplyr::select(frame, best_swap), by = "frame") %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df_frame <- .
    if (isTRUE(df_frame$best_swap[1])) {
      inst0_idx <- which(df_frame$instance == 0)
      inst1_idx <- which(df_frame$instance == 1)
      tmp_x <- df_frame$x_true[inst0_idx]
      tmp_y <- df_frame$y_true[inst0_idx]
      df_frame$x_true[inst0_idx] <- df_frame$x_true[inst1_idx]
      df_frame$y_true[inst0_idx] <- df_frame$y_true[inst1_idx]
      df_frame$x_true[inst1_idx] <- tmp_x
      df_frame$y_true[inst1_idx] <- tmp_y
    }

# --- 4. Compute MSFE by frame for raw predictions ---
```

```{r}
# --- 0. Clean raw_preds into long format (only Nose, Mid-center, Tail-base) ---
pred_clean_raw0 <- raw_preds %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(x|y)_(Nose|Mid-center|Tail-base)$"),  # ✅ only the three main nodes
    names_to = c("coord", "node"),
    names_pattern = "(x|y)_(.*)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = coord,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frame = as.integer(frame),
    instance = as.integer(instance),
    node = str_to_lower(node),
    node = case_when(
      node %in% c("mid-center", "mid_center", "center") ~ "mid",
      node %in% c("tail-base", "tail_base", "base") ~ "tail",
      TRUE ~ node
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(x_m_pred = x, y_m_pred = y)

# --- 1. Join manual coordinates (already cleaned above) ---
df_eval_raw0 <- pred_clean_raw0 %>%
  inner_join(manual_clean, by = c("frame", "instance", "node")) %>%
  rename(body_part = node)

# --- 2. Compute per-frame MSFE swap rule (like coords_pred) ---
df_swap_flags_raw0 <- df_eval_raw0 %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  summarise(
    msfe_no_swap = mean(
      (x_m_pred[instance == 0] - x_true[instance == 0])^2 +
      (y_m_pred[instance == 0] - y_true[instance == 0])^2 +
      (x_m_pred[instance == 1] - x_true[instance == 1])^2 +
      (y_m_pred[instance == 1] - y_true[instance == 1])^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    msfe_swap = mean(
      (x_m_pred[instance == 0] - x_true[instance == 1])^2 +
      (y_m_pred[instance == 0] - y_true[instance == 1])^2 +
      (x_m_pred[instance == 1] - x_true[instance == 0])^2 +
      (y_m_pred[instance == 1] - y_true[instance == 0])^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(best_swap = msfe_swap < msfe_no_swap)

# --- 3. Apply swaps where beneficial ---
df_eval_eff_raw0 <- df_eval_raw0 %>%
  left_join(df_swap_flags_raw0 %>% dplyr::select(frame, best_swap), by = "frame") %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df_frame <- .
    if (isTRUE(df_frame$best_swap[1])) {
      inst0_idx <- which(df_frame$instance == 0)
      inst1_idx <- which(df_frame$instance == 1)
      tmp_x <- df_frame$x_true[inst0_idx]
      tmp_y <- df_frame$y_true[inst0_idx]
      df_frame$x_true[inst0_idx] <- df_frame$x_true[inst1_idx]
      df_frame$y_true[inst0_idx] <- df_frame$y_true[inst1_idx]
      df_frame$x_true[inst1_idx] <- tmp_x
      df_frame$y_true[inst1_idx] <- tmp_y
    }
    df_frame
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

msfe_by_frame_raw0 <- df_eval_eff_raw0 %>%
  group_by(frame) %>%
  summarise(
    # count rows with all non-NA for this frame
    n_non_na = sum(!is.na(x_m_pred) & !is.na(y_m_pred) &
                   !is.na(x_true) & !is.na(y_true)),
    n_total = n(),
    msfe = if (n_non_na == n_total) {
      mean((x_m_pred - x_true)^2 + (y_m_pred - y_true)^2)
    } else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    source = "raw_preds",
    prop_non_na = n_non_na / n_total
  )

# overall proportion
overall_prop_non_na <- sum(msfe_by_frame_raw0$n_non_na) / sum(msfe_by_frame_raw0$n_total)
cat("Overall proportion of non-NA values (raw_preds):", round(overall_prop_non_na, 3), "\n")



# --- 5. Combine all three sources ---
msfe_by_frame_combined <- bind_rows(
  msfe_by_frame_raw0,
  msfe_by_frame_raw %>% mutate(source = "coords_pred"),
  msfe_by_frame %>% mutate(source = "smoothed")
)

# --- 6. Pivot wide for comparison ---
msfe_wide <- msfe_by_frame_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(frame, source, msfe) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = source,
    values_from = msfe
  )
colnames(msfe_wide) <- c("Frame", "Raw", "Tracked", "Smoothed")
```
